blocks.text:
Day 3 · After breakfast at the hotel, depart for a full-day excursion to the Atacama Salt Flats, high-altitude lagoons, and Socaire. Visit the high-altitude lagoons of Miscanti and Miñiques, located in the breathtaking Andean landscape. Lunch will be served in Socaire, a village located approximately 100 km southeast of San Pedro de Atacama. Continue to the Atacama Salt Flat (Salar de Atacama), where you will visit Chaxa Lagoon and the Flamingo National Reserve. Here, you will have the opportunity to observe three of the six different flamingo species found in the world.

The journey continues to the town of Toconao, where you will visit the Church of San Lucas and the Campanario Bell Tower. Return to San Pedro de Atacama.

Included: Full-day group excursion · Entrance fees to Chaxa Lagoon and the high-altitude lagoons · Lunch · Breakfast

blocks.text:
Day 4 · Breakfast at the hotel. El Tatio Geysers and Machuca — Half-Day Shared Tour In the language of the Indigenous people who once inhabited these slopes, “Tatio” means “Crying Old Man.” The geysers are located at an altitude of more than 4,000 meters above sea level. The hot-water fountains emerge at sunrise, between 6:00 and 7:00 a.m. At this time, the water and steam fumaroles reach their maximum height, while hundreds of boiling pools create a spectacular sight.

Amid this impressive natural landscape, close to the Andes, we will enjoy a refreshing breakfast that will also help us warm up, as morning temperatures can drop to -2°C. We will then visit a natural pool where you can enjoy a swim in the hot thermal springs of the Cordillera. On the way back to San Pedro de Atacama, we will admire the beautiful landscape, valleys, and local flora and fauna, including the charismatic vicuñas and viscachas.

Afterwards, we will stop in Machuca, a traditional Atacameño village consisting of just a few adobe, thatch, and cactus-wood houses. The local residents are involved in tourism and offer Andean handicrafts and traditional cuisine, including llama meat, sopaipillas, and empanadas. We will also visit the beautiful Church of San Santiago, the patron saint of the village, and a small wetland inhabited by flamingos, ducks, and other birds.

Included: Half-day shared tour with breakfast and entrance fee to El Tatio · Group transfer to Calama Airport

Not included: Flight Calama – Santiago
